sketch.label: Whiteboard sketch of the chat app
sketch.description: An informal sketch: boxes named Server, Channel, Message, and Member, joined left to right by three plain arrows with no key.
sketch.caption: Boxes and arrows without a key: each reader decides what an arrow means.
sketch.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
box "Server" as server
box "Channel" as channel
box "Message" as message
box "Member" as member
server --> channel
channel --> message
message --> member
@enduml

sketch_questions.label: Whiteboard sketch of the chat app
sketch_questions.description: An informal sketch: boxes named Server, Channel, Message, and Member, joined left to right by three plain arrows with no key. Each arrow carries a question mark.
sketch_questions.caption: Boxes and arrows without a key: each reader decides what an arrow means.
sketch_questions.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
box "Server" as server
box "Channel" as channel
box "Message" as message
box "Member" as member
server --> channel : ?
channel --> message : ?
message --> member : ?
@enduml

preview.label: The chat app sketch as a UML class diagram
preview.description: Server owns any number of Channels (filled diamond, 1 at Server). Channel, an abstract class, owns any number of Messages (filled diamond, 1 at Channel). Each Message is written by exactly one Member; a member writes any number of messages; the arrow points to Member.
preview.caption: Every mark here has one UML meaning, and the lesson explains each one.
preview.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
class Server
abstract class Channel
class Message
class Member
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
@enduml

message_markers.description: Class Message with private attributes text: String and author: Member, and public operations edit(text: String) and preview(length: Integer): String.

kinds.label: Generalization of channels
kinds.description: Abstract class Channel, its name in italics with {abstract} below it, with protected attribute name: String, public operation rename(name: String), and abstract operation summary(): String. TextChannel, with topic: String and summary(), and VoiceChannel, with connect(member: Member) and summary(), are subclasses of Channel.
kinds.caption: Inherited attributes and operations are drawn once, in the general class.

kinds_triangle.label: Generalization of channels
kinds_triangle.description: Abstract class Channel, its name in italics with {abstract} below it, with protected attribute name: String, public operation rename(name: String), and abstract operation summary(): String. TextChannel, with topic: String and summary(), and VoiceChannel, with connect(member: Member) and summary(), are subclasses of Channel.
kinds_triangle.caption: Inherited attributes and operations are drawn once, in the general class.

kinds_abstract.label: Generalization of channels
kinds_abstract.description: Abstract class Channel, its name in italics with {abstract} below it, with protected attribute name: String, public operation rename(name: String), and abstract operation summary(): String. TextChannel, with topic: String and summary(), and VoiceChannel, with connect(member: Member) and summary(), are subclasses of Channel.
kinds_abstract.caption: Inherited attributes and operations are drawn once, in the general class.

kinds_substitution.description: Abstract class Channel, its name in italics with {abstract} below it, with protected attribute name: String, public operation rename(name: String), and abstract operation summary(): String. TextChannel, with topic: String and summary(), and VoiceChannel, with connect(member: Member) and summary(), are subclasses of Channel.
kinds_substitution.caption: Inherited attributes and operations are drawn once, in the general class.

mentions.label: The Mentionable interface and its realizations
mentions.description: Interface Mentionable declares mention(): String. Member, with nickname and mention, and abstract class Channel, with name and mention, each realize Mentionable.
mentions.caption: Member and Channel are unrelated classes that keep the same promise.

mentions_realization.label: The Mentionable interface and its realizations
mentions_realization.description: Interface Mentionable declares mention(): String. Member, with nickname and mention, and abstract class Channel, with name and mention, each realize Mentionable.
mentions_realization.caption: Member and Channel are unrelated classes that keep the same promise.

mentions_compare.label: The Mentionable interface and its realizations
mentions_compare.description: Interface Mentionable declares mention(): String. Member, with nickname and mention, and abstract class Channel, with name and mention, each realize Mentionable. TextChannel is a subclass of Channel.
mentions_compare.caption: Member and Channel are unrelated classes that keep the same promise.

author_attribute.label: Message with an author attribute
author_attribute.description: Message lists the attribute author: Member. A separate Member box has no line to Message.
author_attribute.caption: The author reference is still hidden inside an attribute.

author_line.label: Message written by Member
author_line.description: An association labeled written by runs from Message to Member, with an open arrowhead at Member. Message no longer lists author as an attribute.
author_line.caption: The same reference drawn as an association, navigable from Message to Member.

author_navigable.label: Message written by Member
author_navigable.description: An association labeled written by runs from Message to Member, with an open arrowhead at Member. Message no longer lists author as an attribute.
author_navigable.caption: The same reference drawn as an association, navigable from Message to Member.

author_counts.caption: Each number counts the objects at its end that link to one object at the other end.
author_counts.label: Multiplicities of written by
author_counts.description: Message is written by Member: 1 at the Member end, a star at the Message end.
author_counts.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
class Message
class Member
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
callout top of text "1" : Exactly one author per message
callout top of text "*" : Any number of messages per member
@enduml

member_counts.caption: Each number counts the objects at its end that link to one object at the other end.
member_counts.label: Multiplicities of server membership
member_counts.description: Server links to Member, with a star at the Server end and 1..* at the Member end.
member_counts.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
class Server
class Member
Server "*" --> "1..*" Member
callout top of text "1..*" : At least one member per server
callout top of text "*" : Any number of servers per member
@enduml

voice_open.caption: Each number counts the objects at its end that link to one object at the other end.
voice_open.label: VoiceChannel and Member, multiplicities unknown
voice_open.description: VoiceChannel links to Member, with an arrowhead at Member and a question mark at each end in place of the multiplicities.

voice_counts.caption: Each number counts the objects at its end that link to one object at the other end.
voice_counts.label: Multiplicities of VoiceChannel and Member
voice_counts.description: VoiceChannel links to Member, with 0..1 at the VoiceChannel end and a star at the Member end.
voice_counts.source:
@startuml
layout horizontal
class VoiceChannel
class Member
VoiceChannel "0..1" --> "*" Member
callout top of text "0..1" : At most one voice channel per member
callout top of text "*" : Any number of members per voice channel
@enduml

ownership.caption: A filled diamond sits at the whole; each part has at most one owner.
ownership.label: Server owns its channels
ownership.description: Server owns any number of Channels: a filled diamond at Server with 1, a star and an arrowhead at Channel.
ownership.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
class Server
abstract class Channel
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
callout right of edge 1 start : Composition: delete a server, its channels go
@enduml

ownership_messages.caption: A filled diamond sits at the whole; each part has at most one owner.
ownership_messages.label: Servers own channels, channels own messages
ownership_messages.description: Server owns any number of Channels, and Channel owns any number of Messages, each with a filled diamond and 1 at the whole.
ownership_messages.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
class Server
abstract class Channel
class Message
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
callout right of text "1" occurrence 1 : At the diamond: always 1 or 0..1
@enduml

ownership_author_question.caption: A filled diamond sits at the whole; each part has at most one owner.
ownership_author_question.label: Ownership, and the author question
ownership_author_question.description: Server owns Channels and Channel owns Messages with filled diamonds. Message is written by exactly one Member, a plain association with an arrowhead, marked with a question: diamond or not?
ownership_author_question.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
class Server
abstract class Channel
class Message
class Member
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
callout left of text "written by" : Diamond here, or not?
@enduml

ownership_author_answer.caption: A filled diamond sits at the whole; each part has at most one owner.
ownership_author_answer.label: Ownership, and the author answer
ownership_author_answer.description: Server owns Channels and Channel owns Messages with filled diamonds. Message is written by exactly one Member through a plain association: the messages outlive their author.
ownership_author_answer.source:
@startuml
layout vertical
class Server
abstract class Channel
class Message
class Member
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
callout left of text "written by" : No diamond: messages outlive their author
@enduml

grouping.caption: The server owns its categories and channels; a category only groups channels.
grouping.label: Categories group channels
grouping.description: Server owns any number of Categories and any number of Channels, with filled diamonds. Category groups any number of Channels with a hollow diamond at Category and 0..1 there.
grouping.source:
@startuml
class Server
class Category
abstract class Channel
Server "1" *--> "*" Category
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Category "0..1" o--> "*" Channel
callout left of text "0..1" : Aggregation: groups only
@enduml

grouping_plain.caption: The server owns its categories and channels; a category only groups channels.
grouping_plain.label: Categories linked to channels by a plain association
grouping_plain.description: Server owns Categories and Channels with filled diamonds. Category links to any number of Channels through a plain association with 0..1 at Category.
grouping_plain.source:
@startuml
class Server
class Category
abstract class Channel
Server "1" *--> "*" Category
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Category "0..1" --> "*" Channel
callout left of text "0..1" : Also correct: plain line
@enduml

join.label: Server depends on Invite
join.description: Server, with the operation join(invite: Invite, nickname: String): Member, has a dashed dependency arrow to Invite, which has usesLeft: Integer and redeem(). Server links to Member with a star at Server and 1..* at Member.
join.caption: A stored reference is an association; a parameter used once is a dependency.

join_dependency.label: Server depends on Invite
join_dependency.description: Server, with the operation join(invite: Invite, nickname: String): Member, has a dashed dependency arrow to Invite, which has usesLeft: Integer and redeem(). Server links to Member with a star at Server and 1..* at Member.
join_dependency.caption: A stored reference is an association; a parameter used once is a dependency.

join_association.label: Server depends on Invite
join_association.description: Server, with the operation join(invite: Invite, nickname: String): Member, has a dashed dependency arrow to Invite, which has usesLeft: Integer and redeem(). Server links to Member with a star at Server and 1..* at Member.
join_association.caption: A stored reference is an association; a parameter used once is a dependency.

structure.label: A structural view of the chat app
structure.description: Server owns Categories and Channels. Category groups Channels with a hollow diamond, 0..1 at Category. TextChannel and VoiceChannel are subclasses of the abstract class Channel. Channel owns Messages. Each Message is written by exactly one Member. A VoiceChannel holds any number of Members, each in at most one voice channel.
structure.caption: One view answers one question: what owns what, and who links to whom.
structure.source:
@startuml
class Server
class Category
abstract class Channel
class TextChannel
class VoiceChannel
class Message
class Member
Server "1" *--> "*" Category
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Category "0..1" o--> "*" Channel
TextChannel --|> Channel
VoiceChannel --|> Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
VoiceChannel "0..1" --> "*" Member
@enduml

structure_category.label: A structural view of the chat app
structure_category.description: Server owns Categories and Channels. Category groups Channels with a hollow diamond, 0..1 at Category. TextChannel and VoiceChannel are subclasses of the abstract class Channel. Channel owns Messages. Each Message is written by exactly one Member. A VoiceChannel holds any number of Members, each in at most one voice channel.
structure_category.caption: One view answers one question: what owns what, and who links to whom.
structure_category.source:
@startuml
class Server
class Category
abstract class Channel
class TextChannel
class VoiceChannel
class Message
class Member
Server "1" *--> "*" Category
Server "1" *--> "*" Channel
Category "0..1" o--> "*" Channel
TextChannel --|> Channel
VoiceChannel --|> Channel
Channel "1" *--> "*" Message
Message "*" --> "1" Member : written by
VoiceChannel "0..1" --> "*" Member
callout right of text "0..1" occurrence 1 : Groups many channels; each in at most one category
@enduml

roles_open.caption: A new class gets one line for each rule.
roles_open.label: Role before its lines are drawn
roles_open.description: The interface Mentionable and the classes Server, Role, and Member, with no lines between Role and the others.

roles_answer.caption: A new class gets one line for each rule.
roles_answer.label: Role with its three lines
roles_answer.description: Server owns any number of Roles (filled diamond, 1 at Server). Role and Member are joined by a plain association with a star at both ends. Role realizes Mentionable.
roles_answer.source:
@startuml
interface Mentionable
class Server
class Role
class Member
Server "1" *-- "*" Role
Role "*" -- "*" Member
Role ..|> Mentionable
@enduml

cards.title: Classes
cards.text: A box with a name, attributes, and operations; + public, - private, # protected, ~ package.

cards.title: Generalization
cards.text: A solid line with a hollow triangle at the general class; a dashed one at an interface the class realizes.

cards.title: Associations
cards.text: Solid lines between objects with a multiplicity at each end; a filled diamond owns parts, a hollow one only groups them.

cards.title: Dependencies
cards.text: A dashed arrow from a class to one it uses but does not keep, with no multiplicities.
